Camel Premium CMC Wallpaper Adhesive (200g) — Professional-Grade Glue for Non-Adhesive Wallpapers

Get a long-lasting, hotel-quality wallpaper installation with Camel Premium CMC (Carboxymethyl Cellulose) Wallpaper Adhesive — the trusted glue used by professional wallpaper installers across India. This 200g pack mixes with water to create a smooth, strong-hold paste perfect for installing non-self-adhesive wallpapers, large-format rolls, and traditional paste-the-wall wallpapers.

One 200g pack typically covers 8-10 standard wallpaper rolls, depending on the installer's mixing ratio and application technique. Mixes easily with water — the key is achieving the right thick, gel-like texture before applying (similar to thick yogurt consistency). For best results, watch any YouTube wallpaper installation guide to see the proper mixing technique demonstrated visually.

✨ Product Specifications

Feature Details
Pack Size 200g powder
Type CMC (Carboxymethyl Cellulose) wallpaper adhesive
Coverage 8-10 wallpaper rolls per pack (depends on installer's mix ratio & application)
Mixing Mix with water until thick gel-like texture forms
Setting Time 10-15 minutes after mixing (let it rest before applying)
Finish Clear (invisible after drying)
Shelf Life 2 years sealed; use within 48 hrs once mixed

🎯 Key Benefits

  • ✔ Excellent Coverage — One pack handles 8-10 rolls
  • ✔ Professional-Grade Hold — Used by interior designers and installers
  • ✔ Easy Water Mix — Just add water and stir to thick consistency
  • ✔ Smooth Application — Spreads evenly, no streaks
  • ✔ Repositionable — Slide wallpaper into place before it sets
  • ✔ Strong Long-Term Bond — Holds wallpaper for 5+ years
  • ✔ Dries Clear — No yellowing, no visible residue
  • ✔ Universal — Works on paper, vinyl-coated, and non-woven wallpapers
  • ✔ Affordable Pro Quality — The most cost-effective wallpaper glue in India

🛠️ How to Use

  1. Watch a YouTube installation guide first — visual reference helps get the right consistency
  2. Pour clean water into a bucket
  3. Slowly sprinkle the CMC powder while stirring continuously
  4. Keep mixing until you get a thick gel-like texture (similar to thick yogurt or hair gel)
  5. Let it rest for 10-15 minutes to fully activate
  6. Apply with a brush or roller to the back of the wallpaper OR directly to the wall (depending on wallpaper type)
  7. Position wallpaper, smooth out air bubbles from center outward
  8. Clean excess adhesive immediately with a damp cloth
  9. Allow 24 hours for full bond to develop

💡 Pro Installer Tips

  • 🎬 Watch YouTube tutorials — The mixing consistency is everything. Visual learning beats reading instructions
  • 💧 The thicker, the better — Runny paste = weak bond. Thick gel-like paste = strong hold
  • ⏱️ Let it rest — Don't apply immediately after mixing. Wait 10-15 mins for full activation
  • 🧪 Test small first — Try on a small wallpaper strip before doing a full wall
  • 📦 One pack = 8-10 rolls — Plan your purchase accordingly

🏠 Compatible With

Non-self-adhesive wallpapers • Premium 58 sq.ft rolls • Traditional paste-the-wall wallpapers • Imported wallpaper rolls • Vinyl-coated paper wallpapers

⚠️ Important Notes

  • ✅ Use within 48 hours of mixing for best results
  • ✅ Best on clean, smooth, primed walls (POP, painted, plywood)
  • ⚠️ NOT for self-adhesive wallpapers — those don't need glue
  • ⚠️ NOT for bathroom or wet walls — moisture weakens bond
  • 📅 Shelf life: 2 years sealed in dry storage
  • 🛡️ No guarantee policy — Bond quality depends on wall surface, mix consistency, and application technique

Golden tape is designed to be a finishing touch product — it works best when combined with other decor items like wallpapers, 3D panels, or foam sheets. ⚠️ Important — Single-Use Tape

This tape is removable but single-use — once you peel it off a surface, the adhesive backing loses its grip and the tape cannot be re-applied. Plan your layout carefully before sticking. Measure twice, cut once, stick once.

🛠️ How to Use

  1. Plan your layout first — dry-place the roll along the area to visualize the result
  2. Clean the surface thoroughly — remove dust, grease, and moisture
  3. Measure the area you want to trim and pre-mark with pencil if needed
  4. Cut the tape to the desired length with scissors or a sharp cutter
  5. Peel off the backing slowly from one end
  6. Press the tape firmly along the edge or border, working slowly
  7. Smooth out any air bubbles with your finger or a soft cloth
  8. For corners: cut at a 45-degree angle for a clean mitered joint
